title: Wendell and the Tryouts
author: Isandro Crane
blurb: Astrid Underhill, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
